reviewer: author self-review (independent pass over the product route)

route_trace.detail: init_backend calls infinity_backend_oxide::qwen3_vl_alias on the original config before dense oxide admission.
Remote VL requests download modules.json Dense modules and safetensors through the existing Oxide helpers; local requests must carry the same files.
Qwen3VlBackend::new_with_pool is constructed inside the existing spawn_blocking startup worker.
BackendThread owns Box<dyn CoreBackend + Send>; the VL backend is the same worker/lease path as every other backend.
pack_batch consumes Batch.multimodal, per-sequence position_ids, prepared pixels and packed cumulative boundaries.
Qwen3VlEngine owns the loaded model, stream, exactly two HostIo slots, a ticket-retired workspace cache and returns Inference::Deferred for submit_embed.
forward_batch selects raw vs pooled, runs the vision tower + dense decoder, and applies the trained readout.
normal_oxide_factory_detects_qwen3_vl_aliases_before_dense_admission proves the normal factory sees the alias even without a CUDA device.

facade_check.detail: Qwen3VlBackend is returned by the normal init_backend factory and owned by the normal BackendThread. It is not a side binary that the product factory cannot reach.
facade_check.literal_OxideBackend_new: The standard dense OxideBackend::new constructor remains the dense-only path; the product factory dispatches Qwen3-VL immediately before it. Changing OxideBackend::new's return type to an enum would be a separate large refactor and is not claimed.

lifecycle_audit.submit_embed: Qwen3VlEngine::submit returns Inference::Deferred; the synchronous embed wrapper is the only Ready path and is used by probe/tests.
lifecycle_audit.pinned_host_io: HostIo::pool creates exactly two slots; lease.prepare reserves the request key/output, pack_decoder_metadata writes the pinned input, download_output_into writes the pinned output.
lifecycle_audit.ticket: lease.begin_tracked issues the slot clock ticket before the first GPU upload; lease.record records the same-stream event after all launches; DeferredVl.wait calls the event fence and publishes the ticket.
lifecycle_audit.retirement: completed tickets are drained into the free workspace list; in-flight A/B workspaces are held; a third request allocates C after a lease frees. DeferredVl::Drop waits before freeing/retiring, including when the caller drops the Inference.
lifecycle_audit.growth: WorkspaceCache grows a new workspace when no completed ticket is drainable; the HostIo budget returns Overloaded rather than overcommitting.
lifecycle_audit.invalid_media: pack_batch validates every media descriptor before a lease or ticket; the host consumer proves a typed error is recoverable and the next valid request succeeds.
lifecycle_audit.reupload: weights/executor are constructed once in Qwen3VlEngine::new; submit never uploads model weights.
lifecycle_audit.context_bind: one bind per submission in Qwen3VlEngine::submit; forward_outputs_with does not bind; FA4 uses forward_batch_bound; LT and RoPE launches do not bind per op.
